high.title: Banco Master: Less than a month after BCB blocks Daniel Vorcaro's offshore, 'new' Titan created in London
high.summary: This development signals potential regulatory evasion in Brazil's banking sector, with significant implications for BCB oversight and financial system integrity. Less than a month after the Central Bank of Brazil froze assets of Titan Capital Holding (linked to Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro) in the Cayman Islands, a similarly-named entity "Titan Capital Holdings Ltd." was registered in the UK on April 2, 2026. The new company is registered under Victor Henrique Medeiros Lima, a 38-year-old Brazilian soy producer with no financial market background. This raises serious questions about potential asset restructuring to circumvent BCB enforcement actions. For investors, this case highlights ongoing risks in Brazil's banking sector supervision and the challenges regulators face in tracking cross-border financial structures. The timing and naming similarity suggest possible regulatory arbitrage, which could prompt stricter BCB oversight of international corporate structures linked to Brazilian financial institutions. Watch for potential BCB policy responses and enhanced cross-border cooperation measures.

medium.title: Small cap on exchange will pay R$83.1 million in dividends and interest on equity
medium.summary: Grendene (GRND3) approved R$83.1 million in shareholder distributions, with R$82 million as interest on equity (subject to IR withholding) and R$1.13 million as dividends. This represents healthy cash distribution from a small-cap stock, potentially supporting broader equity market sentiment and dividend yield expectations in the Brazilian market.

medium.title: Small cap on exchange updates payment of R$150 million in dividends; see dates and value per share
medium.summary: Iguatemi (IGTI11) updated its R$150 million dividend distribution schedule for 2026, with payments on April 29, July 29, and October 29. The per-share values were recalculated due to recent share buybacks, maintaining the total amount while adjusting individual payouts based on reduced share count.
